en.headline: FIBA 3x3 World Tour returns to Victoria Park this weekend
en.dek: Sixteen professional teams compete at Causeway Bay on 28 and 29 November, with a free carnival village opening on Friday; Team Hong Kong is among the sides.
body: The FIBA 3x3 World Tour Hong Kong 2026 takes place at Victoria Park in Causeway Bay on 28 and 29 November. Sixteen professional teams will contest the title at the No. 1-3 Soccer Pitches, with the qualifying draw and pool games on Saturday and knockout stages on Sunday.

Organisers said the event includes a free-admission 3x3 Village carnival from 27 to 29 November featuring interactive sports trials, basketball challenges and other activities. Team Hong Kong, which includes players who have represented the city, is one of the competing sides. The tournament carries more than HK$1 million in prize money according to the Hong Kong Tourism Board listing.

Tickets for the competition sessions are on sale, with prices starting from HK$20 for certain Saturday slots. The carnival itself requires no ticket. The venue is a public park in one of the city's busiest districts, with matches scheduled across both days of the weekend.

zh.headline: FIBA 3x3世界巡迴賽本周末重臨維多利亞公園
zh.dek: 16支職業球隊28及29日於銅鑼灣競逐，周五起設免費嘉年華；香港隊亦有出賽。
body: FIBA 3x3世界巡迴賽香港站2026將於11月28及29日在銅鑼灣維多利亞公園1至3號足球場舉行。16支職業球隊角逐冠軍，周六進行資格賽及分組賽，周日則進行淘汰賽。
主辦方表示，11月27至29日設免費入場的3x3 Village嘉年華，包括互動運動體驗及投籃挑戰等活動。香港隊是參賽隊伍之一，成員包括曾代表港隊的球員。香港旅遊發展局資料顯示賽事總獎金超過100萬港元。
比賽時段門票已公開發售，部分周六時段最低票價為20港元。嘉年華本身免費入場。場地為市中心公眾公園，兩日均有賽事安排。
